rules.PRE_ENTRY: empty history; no locked FIRST80 position yet
rules.HEALTHY: EV>=0 and this segment has never entered distress
rules.WATCH_NEGATIVE: EV<0 and first valid negative of the current streak
rules.PERSISTENCE_2: current and immediately previous adjacent valid PRIMARY both EV<0
rules.PERSISTENCE_3PLUS: current plus at least two immediately previous adjacent valids EV<0
rules.RECOVERING: previous valid EV<0 and current EV>=0
rules.HEALTHY_AFTER_RECOVERY: after RECOVERING, subsequent valid rows that stay EV>=0
rules.UNRESOLVED: current PRIMARY has no valid EV, or continuity cannot be established

gap_rule: An unavailable/invalid PRIMARY checkpoint emits UNRESOLVED and breaks the streak. The next valid row starts a new segment: HEALTHY or WATCH_NEGATIVE. Recovery memory does not survive a gap. Persistence is never inferred across a gap.

archetype_rules.UNRESOLVED_PATH: no valid core state other than UNRESOLVED, or WATCH with no later branch
archetype_rules.PERSISTENCE_TO_RECOVERY: reached PERSISTENCE_2 or PERSISTENCE_3PLUS, later RECOVERING
archetype_rules.NEGATIVE_TO_PERSISTENCE_2: reached PERSISTENCE_2, never PERSISTENCE_3PLUS, never RECOVERING
archetype_rules.NEGATIVE_TO_RECOVERY: WATCH then RECOVERING after other observed distress not covered above
